servicos.frase: To understand the origin of what you feel and repeat.
servicos.para_quem: For anyone noticing patterns that keep repeating, a racing mind or a habit that is hard to control.
servicos.como_funciona: A listening session, grounded in psychoanalysis and behavior, to look calmly at your story.
servicos.mensagem_whatsapp: Hi, Lívia! I found you through your website and I'd like to know more about the Therapy Session.

servicos.frase: A moment to slow down, breathe and come back to yourself.
servicos.para_quem: For anyone whose body feels tired and who wants time to pause, without having to talk much.
servicos.como_funciona: You settle into a quiet place and receive Reiki as complementary care.
servicos.formato: Online, by video or at a distance

servicos.frase: You settle in wherever you are. Afterwards, you get feedback as an audio message.
servicos.para_quem: For anyone feeling a heavy energy who prefers to be cared for without leaving home.
servicos.como_funciona: The session happens at a distance only. At the end, Lívia sends what she noticed as an audio message on WhatsApp.
servicos.formato: At a distance only, with audio feedback
